artworks.title: Naval Battle in the Straits of Messina
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a harbor scene depicting the city of Messina. The horizon is dominated by distant mountains and cityscape with tall buildings. Above, there are swirling cloud formations in a dramatic sky. The style features intricate engraving techniques, with fine lines detailing ships and buildings. A large galleon with full sails is closest to us in the lower left, with other ships of various sizes and styles scattered across the water. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the maritime setting against land and sea structures.

artworks.title: The Alchemist
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 31.9 x 45 cm (12 9/16 x 17 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print of a cluttered interior with various alchemical activities happening. The room is filled with containers, tools, and books. A man on the left sits at a desk, mixing different elements together in a small bowl while several other bowls emit smoke. In the center, two people crouch on the floor near another fire. On the right, a person sits, reading several large books, and extending one hand outward towards the people in the center. In the background on the left, three children appear to be climbing into a cabinet. On the right, an open window shows several people walking towards a building labeled "lospital." Below the print are several lines of text.

artworks.title: The Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.9 x 26 cm (7 13/16 x 10 1/4 in.)
support: 30 x 37 cm (11 13/16 x 14 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, like standing on a small hill looking into a wooded area. The horizon is implied by a gentle arc of darker shaded foliage in the middle, creating a sense of distance. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, emphasizing quick, gestural movements capturing trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with warm brown ink on a light background. Closer objects have darker shadows on the left with defined tree trunks and foliage, while distant objects are lighter and less defined, blending into the background.

artworks.title: Dancers at the Old Opera House
artworks.medium: pastel over monotype on laid paper
artworks.description: We look slightly down and across a stage, as if from the wings, at a ballet performance with ballerinas to our left and the audience to our right in this vertical print. The artist has added strokes in pastel in some areas, as for the dancers’ pink tights and pointed toe shoes. The whole scene is loosely rendered, either with pastel or in the monotype print on which the artist drew. There are at least three ballerinas lined up in a row moving away from us, along the left edge of the paper. Their dark hair is pulled up and, for the woman farthest from us, two pink flowers adorn her hair. They wear costumes with silvery-white bodices and flaring, knee-length tutus. An area streaked with pine green and brown in the upper left corner could be a curtain behind the dancers, and people wearing black watch from red box seats across the stage from us. The surface of the stage itself is a blend of charcoal gray and rose pink, and the edge is lined with white to our right. The audience is a made up of a few peach dots within strokes and smudges of black. More gold and brick-red box seats fill the wall opposite us. There is a black silhouette along the right edge of the paper, with a bulge near the bottom right corner perhaps indicating the shoulder of an onlooker from the wings, next to us. The artist signed the work with vibrant blue near the lower right corner, “degas.”

artworks.title: Ballet Dancers
artworks.description: Three pale-skinned ballet dancers wearing orange and dark turquoise costumes stand together on a stage in this square composition, which is painted with gouache and drawn with pastel over a monotype print. The dancers are close together near the center of the drawing, between two scrims representing trees, bushes, and grass on the theater set. A backdrop beyond suggests bushes and a tan-colored mountain under a blue sky. Two ballerinas face away from us. The dancer to the left has long, copper-red hair, and the one to the right has long brown hair. That second dancer leans onto one pointed toe. The third dancer, also with brown hair, is closer to and faces us, but she bends forward to adjust one shoe, and her face is hidden behind the stage setting. All three have peach-colored flowers in their hair, and their costumes have knee-length tutus with alternating layers of orange and turquoise. Swag sleeves lie across the dancers' upper arms from their low-cut bodices, and all three wear pale pink ballet slippers. The scene is drawn and painted with loose, visible strokes of paint and pastel, making many details indistinct. The artist signed the lower left corner, “Degas.”

artworks.title: Sheep
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple sheep in various poses. The full-page illustration depicts several sheep lying down. The fur of the sheep is textured with detailed pencil strokes, and there are subtle hints of shadow beneath each animal. There is a combination of different angles and poses, showing the sheep from different perspectives. The drawing also contains some rough sketches and outlines, suggesting movement and presence without complete detail. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Four Women at Trouville
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of several figures dressed in flowing garments. The painting utilizes a soft, muted color palette consisting primarily of blues, grays, and a touch of red, applied in a loose and fluid style. The sweeping lines and shapes create a sense of flowing motion among the figures. The background is minimal, allowing the focus to remain on the elegant drapery and form of the garments.

artworks.title: Loading the Boats
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people by a docked sailboat. The horizon is positioned high in the image, separating the light blue sea from the sky. The sailboat is at the center with a large sail. Loose brushstrokes create a sense of movement. The color scheme is subdued with browns, grays, and hints of blue. Two figures are seated close by, seemingly conversing, while others gather on and around the boat. The scene conveys a tranquil moment captured in watercolor.

artworks.title: Seascape with Sailing Vessel
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with the sea stretching into the distance. The horizon is low in the composition, with a line where the water meets the sky. A ship with multiple sails is to the right, portrayed with broad, impressionistic brushstrokes. The color palette includes grays, blues, and browns. The sea has light strokes to depict gentle waves, and the sky above has soft, wispy strokes of blue and gray.

artworks.title: Ships in Harbor
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with a sailing ship on the left side and other ships and land in the distance, depicted with loose pencil lines. The color palette is limited to beige and light gray tones. Distant vessels and structures are visible against the horizon and the sky is depicted with light cloud formations.

artworks.title: Sun-Shades, Trouville
artworks.description: This watercolor painting depicts a beach scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned just above the midway line of the painting, where the sea meets the sky. Loose brushstrokes create a casual, impressionistic feeling, especially in the sky and water. The color palette is soft and muted, dominated by light browns, blues, and sandy tones, with pops of color from the beachgoers' umbrellas. Figures are shown seated with umbrellas and a dog lies on the beach. More figures are enjoying the seaside in the distance. The background blends softly where the sky and sea meet.

artworks.title: Three Women at Trouville
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This painting shows three women displayed from head to toe. They are standing in a group, facing each other, with their bodies slightly inclined inward. The brushstrokes in the painting are wide and fluid, and women have no visible facial features. They appear to have dark hair underneath hats with blue ribbons. Their clothing consists of long dresses with voluminous skirts. The woman in the center wears a vibrant red shawl over her shoulders, while the other dresses are in muted tones of blue and gray. The background is a plain beige-gray color, and the ground is gray.

artworks.title: Child Seated on a Sofa
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a child seated on a sofa or chair with legs hanging over the side. The child has long, dark hair with bangs, a neutral expression, and is dressed in a dark dress with a white collar and stockings.

artworks.title: Venice
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 17.2 x 24.6 cm (6 3/4 x 9 11/16 in.)
support: 18.9 x 26.6 cm (7 7/16 x 10 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The painting shows a waterfront scene with red and white sailboats on the water to the left. In the background, there are pink buildings with white and teal domes and a tall clock tower. On the far right, people are walking along a gray pathway next to the water. The sky is blue and filled with fluffy clouds in white, purple, and pink. The brushstrokes are loose and thick, and the off-white paper below shows through in several places.

artworks.title: George Mills
artworks.medium: pastel with gray and brown wash on two overlapped sheets of laid paper joined at the top
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He faces slightly to the right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has light-colored, curly hair styled neatly, falling just above his collar. His features include a youthful face with fair skin, eyebrows, and lips. He wears historical attire: a deep blue coat with brass buttons, a white waistcoat, and a white cravat tied at the neck. The background shows an indistinct, neutral-toned wall that suggests an interior space.

artworks.title: Mrs. George Mills
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body in profile, facing left. She has delicate facial features, soft expression, high styled hair covered by a large bonnet, and wears an elegant dress with ruffled details and a fitted waist. She wears a black ribbon choker. The background includes a tree, suggesting an outdoor scene. The artwork features soft, pastel coloration.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile from the waist up. She has delicate facial features, a smooth complexion, and a slightly pointed nose. Her hair is styled in an updo with curls, possibly adorned with a hairpiece. She wears a dress with a cinched waist, detailed with a belt or band with a circular ornament. The dress appears to be subtly draped. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is an oval frame with dark clouds and a lighter, hazy area behind the figure.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Blue Sash
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman's upper body in profile facing left. She has a refined profile with a slightly upturned nose and delicate chin. Her hair is styled in tight curls with a headband. She wears a light-colored gown with a scoop neckline and a darker sash around her waist. The gown appears to have subtle designs or embroidery. She wears a necklace made of beads or pearls. The background shows a softly shaded, cloudy sky within an oval border.

artworks.title: Woman Seated at a Table, Holding a Letter
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 34.3 x 24.2 cm (13 1/2 x 9 1/2 in.)
support: 40.5 x 30.2 cm (15 15/16 x 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a three-quarter profile. She has fair skin, light-colored hair styled in soft curls, and wears a light-colored cap. She is dressed in an elegant dark gown with lace detailing, a light-colored skirt, and a white shawl. She holds an envelope with a red wax seal in her right hand. Next to her is a table with a letter-writing set and a fabric piece. The background features tall trees seen through a window or open drapery.

artworks.title: Two Children
artworks.artist: British 19th Century after George Henry Harlow
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic drawing of two children's upper bodies facing each other. One child has shoulder-length curly hair and a profile view, looking up at the other child. The child on the right has a round face, short hair under a bonnet, and is in a three-quarter view looking down. Both children wear simple, flowing garments without visible patterns. The drawing is done in soft pencil tones with a hint of color, giving a gentle appearance. The background is plain paper with a fading oval vignette effect, emphasizing the children.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man in a Military Uniform
artworks.medium: black, blue, and red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an oval portrait of a man's upper torso. He is turned slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The man has pale skin, defined facial features, softly arched eyebrows, a subtle mustache, and styled hair in an 18th-century fashion. He wears a blue coat with white lapels, silver buttons, and a silver-fringed epaulet on the shoulder, along with a cravat and waistcoat. The background is a smooth, neutral gray.

artworks.title: Carriage with Driver and Groom: Autumn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage. The image shows a carriage pulled by two horses. The horses are depicted with a loose and flowing style typical of sketch work. The horses stand side by side, with their heads slightly turned. The carriage is illustrated with elegance and minimal detailing. The background of the drawing suggests a street-side setting with faint outlines of buildings. The individuals associated with the carriage are represented in a simplified manner, wearing period-appropriate attire. The overall tonal quality of the drawing is purposefully muted.

artworks.title: Carriage with Driver and Groom: Spring
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of a horse-drawn carriage. It depicts two horses hitched to a carriage using watercolor and ink in light blues and earthy tones. The carriage is blue, with a coachman wearing a traditional uniform and a top hat sitting atop it. Another figure, similarly dressed, stands beside the carriage. The horses have noticeable musculature and realistic details. Soft shadows are cast on the ground beneath them, and the background suggests an open, light atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Duchess of Kent's State Carriage
artworks.description: This is a painting of a military procession. The painting depicts a scene of a parade or inspection with soldiers and horses. A central group of mounted figures could denote a leader or dignitary with a distinctive hat, surrounded by guards on horseback. The soldiers are dressed in historical military attire with decorative uniforms and helmets, suggesting a ceremonial event. The left side features soldiers carrying spears, and there are horses with blue saddle decorations adding color to the scene. The background is a soft blend of blues and earth tones.
